title: Anna’s Reel
author: Rick Mohr
problems: Row 5 "robins start a half hey - lefts in center, rights on ends" can't start from where the dancers are: A hey needs one dancer at each end of the line, one on each side.
Row 8 "larks allemande left 1½" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 2 are too far apart to turn by the hand.

Row 9 "form an ocean wave & balance - larks by left hands and neighbors by right hands" can't start from where the dancers are: Both ends would take the same end of the wave; the hands named do not fit how the dancers face.
Row 13 "larks balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing pairs a lark with a robin.
Row 14 "partners balance & swing · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 0 and 1 are too far apart to balance.
The progression after row 3 "neighbors allemande left ¾" doesn't work out: No couples meet new neighbors here.
Row 1 "robins allemande right 1½" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 1 and 3 are too far apart to turn by the hand.

Row 2 "form an ocean wave & balance - robins by right hands and neighbors by left hands" can't start from where the dancers are: Both ends would take the same end of the wave; the hands named do not fit how the dancers face.
Row 5 "robins start a half hey - lefts in center, rights on ends" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers in the middle of a hey must start on opposite sides of the set.
Row 6 "robins balance & swing in the center · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers 1 and 3 are too far apart to balance.
Row 7 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 14 "partners balance & swing · swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
